open_points.subject: OWNER_FORM_FIELDS delivery to owner page and reader
open_points.question: Which modules consume `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS`, and may the owner page receive its field definitions through a generated artifact while only the owner interface imports the constant, or must both page and reader consume the imported constant directly?
options: The owner interface imports the constant, while generation derives the owner-page artifact from the same constant.
Both the owner page and the owner interface consume the imported constant directly.
open_points.default_guess: Have the owner interface import the constant and generate the owner-page artifact from that same release value.
consequences: The module boundary must require generation to derive the page artifact from the provider constant and require the reader to use the imported constant; later notes and imports must preserve that shared source.
The module boundary must expose the provider constant to both runtime consumers, increasing coupling but making their shared source direct.
open_points.requirement: The table holds the names so that the page and the reader cannot name a field differently (Route B runs of 2026-11-25).
